name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Apply the V0.71 benchmark result. Keep the built-in 6x8 font because it was faster than 1-bit drawImage (F=287 ms vs I=445 ms, with only 50 raw bitmap bytes). Attack the real bottleneck instead: replace Date-heavy Japanese holiday/day-number calculations with allocation-free civil-date arithmetic, precompute each page's 35 holiday flags and day numbers into two 35-byte Uint8Arrays before LCD drawing, and remove Date.UTC from both calendar and Orbit date handoff. Restore the requested 400 ms double-tap window. Diagnostics show T total, D LCD draw, C page-data/holiday calculation, P pre-start.
